street._method: Every broker that discloses a method values Chola on P/B on FY28E (Mar-28E) book: Motilal Oswal 4.0x, Emkay 3.8x, Prabhudas Lilladher 3.8x adjusted book.

events.title: Composite QIP: ₹2,000 cr equity + ₹2,000 cr 7.5% CCDs
events.detail: Floor price ₹1,200.51. CCDs convertible from 30-Sep-2025 at a 15-16.5% discount to the 7-day VWAP, compulsorily by 30-Sep-2026.
events.src: Annual Report FY26 (CCD terms, note 17); q1ppt p6

events.title: Ravindra Kundu becomes Managing Director
events.detail: Vellayan Subbiah (Murugappa family) became whole-time Executive Chairman from 1-Apr-2025.
events.src: Annual Report FY26, corporate governance report

events.title: FY26 guidance: AUM 20-25%, credit cost 1.4% → 1.3%
events.detail: Delivered AUM +21% but credit cost 1.6% before overlay (1.7% incl.): a miss, led by vehicle finance and CSEL's fintech book.

events.title: Cobrapost alleges ₹10,262 cr of related-party routing and ₹25,000 cr of cash deposits
events.detail: Company called the claims 'malicious and baseless' on an investor call (23-Dec-2025): cash comes from small transport operators' EMIs; related-party flows are mainly borrower insurance premiums paid to group insurer Chola MS. Stock fell 4-6% then rose ~6% on 23-Dec. No regulatory action found by 30-Sep-2026.

events.title: Q4FY26: ₹200 cr management overlay
events.detail: Precaution against fuel-price, LPG and shipping disruption from the West Asia conflict; FY26 PBT +21%, ROE 19.7%.

events.title: Q1FY27: PAT +46%, ROE 21.2%; disbursement now recognised at cheque clearance
events.detail: Business AUM +22%; NIM 8.2%; credit cost 1.5%; Stage 3 3.29% (+24bp QoQ, seasonal per management).

events.title: ₹200 cr of CCDs converted at ₹1,476.08
events.detail: 20,000 CCDs, ~13.55 lakh shares (16.5% discount to the 7-day VWAP before 1-Jul-2026).

events.title: IRDAI consultation paper on insurance distribution
events.detail: Proposes commission caps of ~2-5% on loan-linked insurance sold by banks and lenders (NBFC credit-life commissions 7-47% today), limits on staff incentives and safeguards against bundling; comments to 25-Oct-2026. NBFC stocks fell on 24-Sep (L&T Finance −8% intraday; Chola also lower).

events.title: Last ₹430 cr of CCDs converted at ₹1,407.59
events.detail: 30,54,849 shares allotted; paid-up shares 85,75,10,806. All ₹2,000 cr of CCDs now equity.

market.detail: September 2026 sell-off: Nifty and Sensex down ~5% for the month by 28-Sep on foreign selling (₹17,131 cr month to date), Brent ~$106 and US 10-year yields at 5.2%; a majority of economists polled expected a 25bp repo hike to 5.5% at the next RBI meeting. Listed NBFCs fell 4-16% between 31-Jul and 30-Sep; Chola fell from ₹1,846 (11-Sep) to ₹1,620.

regulatory.upperLayer: NBFC-Upper Layer under RBI scale-based regulation (company timeline: FY23): bank-like governance, CAR ≥15%, Tier 1 ≥10%.
regulatory.riskWeights: 125% risk weight on unsecured consumer credit since Nov-2023 (hits CSEL); the extra weight on bank loans to NBFCs was reversed from Apr-2025.
regulatory.revolvingCredit: RBI draft (6-Aug-2026) barring NBFCs from revolving credit: no revolving products disclosed by Chola; not material in our reading.
regulatory.insurance: IRDAI consultation (23-Sep-2026): see events. Chola's insurance agency and other commission was ₹1,136 cr in FY26 (~16% of PBT).

ownership.institutions: Holders above 1% named by the company (Jun-2026, no percentages): Axis, SBI, Kotak, ICICI Prudential, HDFC, Invesco and DSP mutual funds; Capital Group, Vanguard, BlackRock, Fidelity, JP Morgan, Norges Bank.
ownership.note: Foreign investors cut from 27.96% (Jun-25) to 24.46%; domestic institutions rose from 16.05% to 20.62%. Promoter share slipped from 49.90% as CCDs converted. Shareholders 1,51,219 (1,83,933 a year earlier).
ownership.src: Screener.in shareholding (BSE pattern); q1ppt p16; Prabhudas Lilladher (29-Jul-2026) for the MF split

conflicts: AUM: the chairman quotes AUM of ₹2,54,392 cr (includes cash and investments); the business AUM is ₹2,33,586 cr. Brokers (Motilal Oswal) and we use business AUM.
Asset quality: Ind AS Stage 3 3.29% vs RBI-norm GNPA 4.50% (Jun-2026); the RBI measure keeps upgraded loans as NPA until all dues are paid.
CCDs: the Q1 call (28-Jul) said the last ₹430 cr would convert in October 2026; the allotment was made on 30-Sep-2026, the maturity date.
EPS: Screener FY26 ₹61.41 (year-end shares) vs annual report basic ₹61.98 (weighted shares).
Credit cost basis: company 1.5% of assets in Q1FY27 vs 1.61% of average business AUM (our basis).
